From a pub residency to Henrietta Street

Founder Max Lewis built Lenny's following with a residency at the Bedford Tavern in Finsbury Park from 2024, serving New Haven style apizza to a growing crowd.

On 27 October 2026, Lenny's opened its first permanent restaurant in Covent Garden, in partnership with the MJMK restaurant group. Same fire, same char, now with a room of its own.

  • StyleNew Haven apizza
  • Opened27 October 2026
  • Before thisBedford Tavern residency, from 2024
  • Good to knowWalk-ins always welcome

The char is the point

Apizza is not pizza that got left in too long. The blistering is the recipe. Keep scrolling and watch this pie go the full distance, from pale dough to the deep char a New Haven oven leaves behind.

Blistered and charred

Crispy at the edge, chewy in the middle, charred where the fire catches it.

The pies

Thin, fired hard, and cut for sharing. These are the pies that built the queue at the residency, now coming out of the Henrietta Street oven.

The Lenny

The signature 14 inch pie. Half tomato, garlic and pecorino, half classic mozzarella, so the table never has to choose.

The signature

Handsome Dan's Potato Pie

Sliced potato layered over the thin, chewy base and fired until the edges catch and crisp.

The cult order

Pepperoni Pie

Pepperoni that cups and crisps in the heat, over mozzarella and tomato on the signature charred base.

The crowd pleaser

Before and after the pie

Shrimp Cocktail

Shrimp served over ice with cocktail sauce and lemon. The old school way to start.

Caesar Salad

Crisp romaine, golden croutons and shaved parmesan in a classic Caesar dressing.

Tiramisu

Coffee soaked layers under mascarpone cream, finished with a dusting of cocoa.

Find the fire

Lenny's first permanent restaurant sits on Henrietta Street in the heart of Covent Garden. Walk-ins are always welcome, and the way to reach the team is Instagram.
